title: Parse bounded payer in-network rate samples
objective: Payer samples preserve rate, code and provider-reference context.
outcome: Pin CMS payer in-network-rates schema v2.2.1 and official fictional rate fixtures. Unsupported schema/rate types are typed, not coerced into a dollar comparison. Stopping before end-of-file produces a partial-validation receipt; row order and file prefixes do not define a representative sample. No utilization weights, patient liability or observed paid-price claims are generated from a negotiated-rate object. The parser does not load a giant file into Worker memory. A rate without sufficient provider/network context remains incomplete. Last-good generation live-2026-09-03-85b50522b420 is unchanged.

commits.subject: Pin in-network schemas and rate fixtures
commits.instructions: Retain CMS schema version/commit and cases for fee-for-service, bundle, percentage and other documented rate forms.
commits.verification: Unsupported schema/rate types are typed, not coerced into a dollar comparison.

commits.subject: Stream selected rate objects
commits.instructions: Bound bytes, decompression, item count and reference fan-out; preserve billing code type/version, modifiers, arrangement, service codes, rate expiration and references.
commits.verification: Stopping before end-of-file produces a partial-validation receipt; row order and file prefixes do not define a representative sample.

commits.subject: Normalize the sample with caveats
commits.instructions: Emit source pointers and exact rate dimensions through the pricing metadata contract. Describe what a research user can and cannot infer.
commits.verification: No utilization weights, patient liability or observed paid-price claims are generated from a negotiated-rate object.
